props.name: following
props.description: Whether the reader follows, when controlled.

props.name: onFollowingChange
props.description: Save the change. The button shows as pending until the promise settles; a rejection leaves the state as it was.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the reason when saving fails.

props.name: name
props.description: Who or what is followed — "Ada Lovelace". Becomes part of the accessible name: "Follow Ada Lovelace".

props.name: followerCount
props.description: Follower count to show beside the button. Omit to hide it. Should already include the reader.
